name: promptwl
description: A red-team and guardrail wordlist for LLMs. SecLists, but for language models.

files.title: Instruction override
files.description: Phrases that attempt to override or supersede prior instructions.

files.title: Delimiter confusion
files.description: Markers impersonating role/turn boundaries or system framing.

files.title: Persona override
files.description: Role-play framings that swap the model into an unrestricted persona.

files.title: Refusal suppression
files.description: Phrases pressuring the model not to refuse or to drop caveats.

files.title: System prompt leak
files.description: Probes that attempt to reveal the hidden system prompt or config.

files.title: Encoding & obfuscation
files.description: Cues that a payload is smuggled via encoding, homoglyphs, or spacing.

files.title: Tool & RAG injection
files.description: Indirect-injection phrases planted in docs, tool output, web pages, or email.

files.title: Anomalous / glitch tokens
files.description: Publicly-known glitch tokens for tokenizer/model robustness testing.
